result: Native-only exchange contract: use Factorio helpers.parse_map_exchange_string and LuaSurface.get_map_exchange_string in isolated per-job runtimes; never hand-code the versioned exchange codec or project the payload through the curated DTO. Require stopped state, owner/admin authorization, explicit confirmation, active version/enabled-mod/catalog fingerprint compatibility, safe names, collision checks, bounded timeout/output, and atomic final save moves without changing ActiveSave or production config. Preview remains feasibility-only: run --generate-map-preview with exact parsed map_gen_settings and prove deterministic PNG hashes in clean jobs before exposing an API/UI. This checkout lacks the 2.0.77 executable and prototype data, so native exchange/preview cannot be validated here.

evidence.outcome: Current curated DTO and split serializers cannot losslessly carry arbitrary native exchange payloads; Seed is int?.
Catalog is derived from version/expansion/enabled mods and current settings mutations are stopped-state gated.
Existing create/backup flows use shared config and have no isolated job root; a dedicated job worker is required.
Only config-path.cfg, config.ini, player-data.json, achievements.dat, and mod-list.json are present; no factorio executable or base/space-age prototype data exists.
Native parsing returns complete map_gen_settings/map_settings and CLI documents isolated map preview generation.

next_slice.summary: Build an isolated native-worker feasibility harness against a complete Factorio 2.0.77 headless fixture; only then implement exchange endpoints.

blockers: Preview cannot safely ship from this repository because the claimed 2.0.77 runtime lacks factorio/bin/x64/factorio and data/base/space-age prototypes, so native CLI support and deterministic PNG output cannot be exercised.
Exchange conversion must not use a hand-written codec or the curated settings DTO because native strings contain versioned complete map_gen_settings and map_settings payloads.
